MOLE MARBLES - a RetroStone VC game for Windows
(c) 2026 Pierre-Louis Boyer (8BCraft). Code MIT; art/music/sound CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
See LICENSE-molemarbles.txt.

A helmeted mole hunts bouncing gemstone balls in an endless crystal cavern.
Move beneath their bounce arcs and launch an upward harpoon. Both its tip and
trailing rope break a ball into two smaller ones; the smallest balls shatter.
Hold A to keep firing after each rope ends. Move away before a ball lands!

Run MoleMarbles.exe. SDL2 is included; no installation is needed.

Controls                    Gamepad                 Keyboard P1 / P2
 Move                       Left / Right            Arrow keys / A,D
 Harpoon / start            A                       X / H
 Start                      Start                   Enter / T
 Pause / resume             Select / Start          Backspace,Esc / R
 Join on the title          A on a free pad         H for P2
 Leave the title lobby      B                       Z / G
 Back to title from results A / Start / Select

One to four full-size moles share one cavern and the same balls. Each player
has their own harpoon and score. Players do not block each other. Survivors
continue when a mole is hit. Pads 3 and 4 need controllers.

The title shows the actual frozen starting position. A starts that scene.
The opening ball is tiny, slow and protected for one second. New balls show a gold
ceiling warning for 1.5 seconds before falling in. Split balls gently pulse and are
harmless for 0.7 seconds; there are no symbols beside them. All ball sizes bounce high enough to run underneath.
Marbles arrive on a randomized steady timer while others are still bouncing.
An empty cavern refills after one second. Single tiny marbles come first;
larger sizes and mixed one/two/three-ball groups unlock gradually with score.
Opening motion is 30% slower and normal bounce arcs are about 50% higher.
All existing marbles accelerate gradually with score, to a capped speed.

10 points per split; 15 for clearing a smallest ball. Medals at 50,150,300,600.
F11 / Alt+Enter: fullscreen. F12: screenshot. Close the window to quit.
Options: MoleMarbles.exe --scale 4 --fullscreen
Best score is saved in molemarbles.srm alongside the executable.
